Source: petersen:page-0315 ↗ def:pet-ch7-ray-line 1. ch7:7.3.4The Schwarzschild metric on $S^{n-2}\times \mathbb {R}^2$ contains no lines, as follows from the splitting theorem (item 2) since the space is not metrically a product. \end{example}
